svg.title: Aeroscapes Reimagine: fairytale moon phases
svg.desc: Eight 96 by 96 cells in Minecraft 1.21.1 order, four columns by two rows: full Moon, waning gibbous, third quarter, waning crescent, new Moon, waxing crescent, first quarter, waxing gibbous. One fixed blue cratered surface is masked for each phase; the new Moon is transparent. Original AI-assisted deterministic pixel composition; no third-party image inputs or generative image models. GPL-3.0-or-later.
